pr_title: debconf: handle boolean value representation consistently
pr_body:
##### SUMMARY

A past commit normalized the representation of values for boolean vtype as string for consistency with debconf values, but only if the question had been seen before.   A different past commit updated a different normalization with an incorrect assumption that the value would be type string.   As  a result, a boolean setting for a question not seen before would attempt to invoke a non-existent `lower()` method.

* lift code that normalizes value type for boolean vtype to cover both branches of conditional.
* remove obsolete and incomplete conversion of type in set_selection.

Fixes: #83594

issue_context.title: debconf module fails to correctly handle bool values
issue_context.body:
### Summary

The task below, when run on a debian12 system prior to installing packages (i.e. at a point where `debconf-show wireshark-common` shows no known items) produces the traceback below, because the debconf module attempts to invoke `value.lower()` on a bool value.

This appears to be a bug introduced in 863e2571db5d70b03478fd18efef15c4bde88c10 from #47676.  That commit refactored to change replacement of specific capitalized string values with a lower-case equivalent, without first checking that the value type was `str`.

A workaround until a fix is implemented is to use an explicit string value `"true"` rather than the unquoted `true`.
